summary: Local Health and Wellness announces a six-week series of Wellness Workshops on Sleep Hygiene and Maximizing Restorative Sleep, starting September 10, 2023 and led by sleep expert Dr. Clara Mendez with a team of specialists. Each weekly session covers a different topic: sleep science, sleep environment, diet, stress and mindfulness, pre-sleep routines, and family-wide sleep habits. The series aims to give attendees practical strategies for better, more restorative sleep.
one_line: Local Health and Wellness announces a six-week sleep hygiene workshop series starting September 10, 2023, led by Dr. Clara Mendez and specialist guest presenters.
key_facts: Local Health and Wellness is hosting Wellness Workshops on Sleep Hygiene and Maximizing Restorative Sleep.
The series begins September 10, 2023, is spearheaded by sleep expert Dr. Clara Mendez, and runs every Thursday evening for six weeks.
Dr. Clara Mendez's team includes certified sleep therapists, nutritionists, and behavioural psychologists.
Dr. Mendez's opening session covers the science of sleep, including REM and non-REM stages, and debunks common sleep myths; she notes we spend about one-third of our lives asleep.
On September 17, 2023, interior designer Nathaniel Thompson, who specializes in therapeutic spaces, covers lighting, temperature, noise control, curtains, and mattresses for the sleep environment.
On September 24, 2023, nutritionist Rachel Kim explains how diet affects sleep, including caffeine, sugar, and foods rich in tryptophan and magnesium, and shares bedtime snack recipes.
On October 1, 2023, clinical psychologist Dr. Samuel Hanson teaches stress management through mindfulness and meditation and covers the harm of blue light from electronic devices.
On October 8, 2023, sleep therapist Laura Greene covers pre-sleep routines, consistent sleep schedules, and relaxation techniques such as reading or taking a warm bath.
Laura Greene says "the hour before bedtime is as crucial as the sleep itself."
On October 15, 2023, child sleep consultant Maria Gonzales leads the final workshop on family sleep hygiene, covering sleep training, teenage sleep cycles, and insomnia in the elderly.
Nathaniel Thompson says "your bedroom should be an oasis of tranquility."
Dr. Samuel Hanson says mindfulness "isn't just meditation—it's about being present and aware."
